generator: fal.ai queue endpoint openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/text-to-image, submitted by scripts/generate-app-art.mjs with FAL_AI_API_KEY from the local environment only
purpose: Original illustrated artwork for App Composer and its five mini-apps: app covers, share cards, the product hero, the owner's Linkarooie banner and the two fictional demo postcards. Decorative illustration only — never vendor UI, never a screenshot and never a real person's photograph.
artDirection: Original adult-animated science fiction: confident dark ink contours, expressive silhouettes, deliberately drawn perspective, strong cel shading in two flat tone steps, inventive but understandable technology, one clear focal event, controlled colour and small visual humour. Entirely illustrated. Graphite/deep navy #1d2330, warm off-white #f4f0e8 and purposeful orange #d95022 as the product foundation; per-app accents cyan #2f9fbd (Link Check), acid green #a5fd0e (Linkarooie), coral #d95022 (Here / there), signal orange #ff9b55 (Hello World) and violet #8b5cf6 (Carry / forward).
superseded: The 14 October mixed glossy set (v1/v2) and the 17 October flat cut-paper screenprint set (v3) are both rejected by the owner and removed from every repository. Their files, prompts and review notes remain in Git history and in .artwork/. No cut-paper scene concept was reused: the v3 art direction itself (no perspective, no shading, flat paper shapes) was superseded.
composition: Each app ships its own square master, 480/960 WebP hero, 1200x630 share card (the same bytes as its catalogue card), a 96px switcher crop and a 512px flat apple-touch icon rendered from its own mark.svg. The App Composer hero and product share card are separate from the app cards.

assets.subject: A red kangaroo works an eccentric retro-futuristic signal selector and holds up one chosen transmission from the many; a small critter nibbles the rejected pile.
assets.notes: Two outputs were generated; -1 was chosen for the clearer focal event.

assets.subject: An original visitor station: a tall alien pins a postcard onto a wall of contributions while a small robot carries a tall stack of cards.
An orbital diagnostic bay: a technician traces a glowing cyan cable to a cracked connector with one small orange spark, while the wall trace stops at the fault.
A tiny newly assembled relay sends its first bright orange signal up to a distant satellite, dwarfed by a huge dark space.
A courier carries a glowing violet memory core between a bulky mainframe and a slim handheld, joined by a continuous signal ribbon.

An assembly hall: two robot arms and an engineer click distinct modules — photo frame, chain link, signal dish, drawer and terminal — into one working machine; a small robot cat supervises with a clipboard.
assets.notes: Two outputs were generated; -2 shows the modular assembly most clearly. The homepage headline and actions stay real HTML; the product share card composes this art with deterministic typography.

assets.subject: A personal signal room: microphone, tape machine with a sleeping robot cat, ham radio, records and guitar, with an orange signal path to a round window showing an impossible space. The left third is deliberately calm for the profile portrait.
A market strung between asteroids above a ringed planet; a four-armed trader holds up a glowing fruit while a tiny robot struggles with a crate.
exports: fictional demo postcard submitted to Here / there

assets.subject: A crooked lighthouse on a slow moon; the keeper climbs with a lantern while the lamp sweeps an orange beam toward an incoming boat.
exports: fictional demo postcard submitted to Here / there

labels: Product names, postcard titles, the fictional-demo label and share-card typography are rendered deterministically from HTML templates in .artwork/og/, never asked of the image model.
